created_prompt: Consider the following: Julie posts cooking videos to 1.2 million followers who love her quick, healthy recipes. Over the next three years, she wants to continue to grow her online presence and publish a cookbook. She works four days a week and has limited time and budget. Given all of this, 1) Should Julie go with traditional or self-publishing for her cookbook, and 2) Create a three-year plan for Julie to help achieve her goals.
